name: BioSkepsis
description: BioSkepsis is an agentic AI research assistant for the life sciences that turns one research question into a verified, cited evidence brief with a Trust Index.

events.d: Get the current status, phase and papers found for a research run.
Get the finished cited brief, sources, coverage and Trust Index of a research run.
List recent saved research briefs or get one saved brief by its ID.
Start an AI research run that answers a life-science question with a cited brief.
Create a scheduled email feed that follows new papers related to a finished research run.
